background.value: Neutral background (official wording is "neutral", not specifically "white")

file_spec.value: Portrait photo (obligatory): neutral background, in color, maximum file size 2 MB, in BMP, JPG, JPEG or PNG format. Applicants are also directed to follow ICAO photo guidelines.

db_conflicts.research_value: "Neutral background" (per the official Liberia Immigration Service visa-on-arrival/eVisa portal) -- officially specified as neutral, not explicitly white, which may permit light grey/off-white tones the DB's strict white requirement would not

cross_verification.note_en: https://visaonarrival.lis.gov.lr/ is the official Liberia Immigration Service (a .gov.lr government domain) eVisa/visa-on-arrival portal, directly fetched and confirmed. Its stated photo rule is 'Neutral background, in color, with a maximum size of 2 MB, in BMP, JPG, JPEG or PNG formats,' with a further reference to ICAO photo guidelines. No exact millimeter size or head-height ratio is published on this page, so those fields are left unverified. The background wording ('neutral') is recorded as a db_conflict against the DB's '흰색' (white) because 'neutral' is the officially used term and is broader than strict white.
